risk_summary: The disclosure is materially negative, reporting a 30.5% decline in retail sales, a 32% same-store sales decline, sharply higher cost ratios, and a net loss. Liquidity was supported by liquidating short-term investments, using the revolving credit facility, suspending dividends, and cutting expenditures. COVID-19 outlook language is heavily qualified and emphasizes uncertainty around duration, severity, consumer behavior, and future restrictions, although the filing provides substantial quantitative detail.
